code='''def transform(grid):
    height = len(grid)
    empty = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 0]
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in empty)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in empty) + 1
    c0 = min(c for _, c in empty)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in empty) + 1
    return [[grid[height - 1 - r][c] if grid[r][c] == 0 else grid[r][c]
             for c in range(c0, c1)] for r in range(r0, r1)]
'''
